Definition
[General integral] ↗ def:complete-integral ↗ def:envelope 1. ch3:3.1.2-def-2\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

Given a complete integral $u(x,a_1,\ldots ,a_n)$ and a smooth function $h:\R ^{n-1}\to \R $, restrict to $a_n=h(a_1,\ldots ,a_{n-1})$ and take the envelope with respect to $a_1,\ldots ,a_{n-1}$. The resulting family, with arbitrary $h$, is the general integral associated with $u$.
